text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp has finally arrived.
As for Lucky Lilac—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll go get changed right away.
Please wait a moment, okay?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Of course. If I don't level up big time during this training camp, I won't stand a chance at winning the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
We cannot afford to waste even a single second.
Trainer, please put your back into it as well.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Lately, I've occasionally felt a strange disconnect
with how my body moves...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(There's no pain or discomfort, so I reckon
I can run in the Shuka Sho, but—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Stop it, stop it! This is no time to be fretting!
I gotta switch gears and focus!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Now's the time to get fired up...!
I'm gonna make this summer camp a total success!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do it...!
To win the Shuka Sho...!!"
